home.pageTitle: Porsche Owners Reunions | Stories that connect generations
home.metaDescription: Discover Owners Reunions, the Porsche project connecting different owners of the same vehicle to rebuild each car's story across time.
home.ogDescription: A Porsche can have many owners, but only one story. Discover how they connect across time.
home.interludeSubtitle:
ONE PORSCHE. MANY LIVES.
OWNERS OF THE SAME CAR REUNITED FOR THE FIRST TIME.
EACH OF THEM A CHAPTER OF A NEVER ENDING STORY.
home.storiesTagline: The story of your Porsche could be the next one.

2.text: It felt like stepping into a time capsule. Suddenly, I got in, closed the door, and I was 29 again.
2.author: Joseline Wong

3.text: You can smell the hot oil and gasoline. No other car sounds the same.
3.author: Rodrigo Baz

4.text: Every car carries a story. Being part of this one is something I'll always be proud of.
4.author: Abdon Hernandez

5.text: This car has been the thread weaving together three generations of motorsport passion—my grandfather's, my father's, and now mine.
5.author: Pablo Esguerra

6.text: I believe the car never truly stops being yours.
6.author: Luis "Lucho" Fischer

items.question: What is "There is no substitute"?
items.answer: It is Porsche's global platform that celebrates the connection between its cars and the people who drive them.

items.question: What is Owners Reunions?
items.answer: It is a project that brings together different owners of the same Porsche to reconstruct the vehicle's complete history over time.

items.question: Why does Porsche connect owners of the same car?
items.answer: Because every Porsche accumulates unique experiences. By reuniting those who drove it, its history can be understood from different perspectives.

items.question: Can any Porsche owner participate?
items.answer: Yes. You can share your story and become part of the project.

items.question: What happens if multiple people share the same vehicle?
items.answer: That information allows us to reconstruct the car's full journey and connect the different moments in its history.

items.question: How are the stories selected?
items.answer: We consider the value of the story, the connection between owners, and the significance of the vehicle within the community.
